modules.title: 同一枚图标怎样进入系统位置
App Icon 为什么需要单独适配

items.title: 系统会改变外框和尺寸
items.text: 主屏幕、搜索和设置可能使用不同大小或平台形状。源图要在安全区域内保留主要图形，避免系统遮罩后文字和关键轮廓消失。

items.title: 简化比塞入更多信息更可靠
items.text: 应用图标承担整体身份识别，小尺寸下应优先保留一个清楚的核心形状。不同平台可以有适配变体，但用户应仍能认出是同一应用。

modules.title: 它不等于 Logo、Favicon 或 UI Icon
modules.text: {c:app-icon} 是操作系统识别应用的图像；{c:logo} 是品牌标志；{c:favicon} 服务浏览器站点位置；{c:icon} 表达界面功能。可以共享母体，但不能只把横向 Logo 或工具栏图标缩小后直接交付。

lessonPractice.title: 主屏幕图标里的品牌文字被系统裁掉了，应该怎样处理？

options.label: 重做安全区域内的简化方形图标，检查主屏幕、搜索和设置中的识别结果
options.feedback: 对。系统会缩放或套用形状，图标应保留清楚的识别中心，不能直接把横向 Logo 当成最终图标。

options.label: 把应用内工具栏图标缩小后直接当作 App Icon
options.feedback: 工具栏图标表达单个功能，应用图标负责识别整个应用，尺寸、语义和展示位置都不同。

options.label: 删除图标里的品牌形状，让系统自己生成一个默认图标
options.feedback: 默认图标会失去应用识别；应调整品牌图形的简化程度和安全区域，而不是放弃身份。

en.title: The system crops the brand text inside the Home Screen icon. What should you do?

options.label: Redesign a simplified square icon within a safe area and check Home Screen, search, and Settings
options.feedback: Correct. The system scales or masks the icon, so its recognition center must remain clear instead of using a horizontal Logo unchanged.

options.label: Shrink an in-app toolbar icon and use it directly as the App Icon
options.feedback: A toolbar icon communicates one function; an App Icon identifies the whole app, so their meanings and surfaces differ.

options.label: Remove the brand shape and let the system generate a default icon
options.feedback: A default icon loses the app's identity. Adjust the brand shape and safe area instead of abandoning recognition.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请用现有品牌形状生成简化、适合系统遮罩的方形 App Icon，保留清楚的识别中心。分别检查主屏幕、系统搜索和设置里的缩放与裁切；不要修改应用内功能图标，也不要把平台尺寸清单当作验收结果。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Create a simplified square App Icon from the existing brand shape with a clear recognition center that survives system masking. Check scaling and cropping on the Home Screen, system search, and Settings. Do not change in-app action icons or treat a platform size list as the acceptance result.

references.title_en: Configuring your app icon using an asset catalog

learning.assumes: You have seen an app icon on a Home Screen or in system search, and have also seen a website Logo or UI icon.
learning.outcome: You can judge whether an App Icon survives system scaling and masking and distinguish it from a Logo, Favicon, and UI Icon.

modules.title: How one icon enters system surfaces
Why an App Icon needs its own adaptation

items.title: The system changes its frame and size
items.text: The Home Screen, search, and Settings may use different sizes or platform shapes. Keep the main artwork inside a safe area so masking does not remove text or key contours.

items.title: Simplification is more reliable than extra detail
items.text: An App Icon identifies the whole app, so a small display should preserve one clear core shape. Platform variants can adapt the artwork while remaining recognizable as the same app.

modules.title: It is not a Logo, Favicon, or UI Icon
modules.text: {c:app-icon} is the image used to identify an app in system surfaces; a {c:logo} is a brand mark; a {c:favicon} serves browser-site surfaces; an {c:icon} communicates a UI function. They may share a source, but a horizontal Logo or toolbar icon cannot simply be shrunk and shipped as the App Icon.

distinctions.label: Logo
distinctions.text: {c:app-icon} adapts a square artwork for system surfaces and safe areas; a {c:logo} is a brand mark used in headers, campaigns, and different backgrounds.

distinctions.label: UI icon
distinctions.text: {c:app-icon} identifies the whole app; an {c:icon} usually expresses one action, object, or status in the page.
